name: Tracker Simulator
description: Per-torrent stealth seeding simulator for testing a tracker and its anti-bot checks. For torrents you switch on in the torrent's menu, it announces to their trackers as stable, human-looking peers whose uploaded and downloaded counters grow gradually. Use it only against trackers you operate or have permission to test. It does not transfer any data.

settings.label: Stealth level
settings.help: basic, medium, high or maximum. More irregularity in announce timing and between peers. Default: high.

settings.label: Client profile
settings.help: auto, qbittorrent_like, transmission_like, deluge_like, custom or debug_obvious (an obvious -DRSIM0- peer id, for finding the bots in tracker logs). Default: auto. A peer keeps the profile it was created with.

settings.label: Custom peer id prefix
settings.help: Up to 8 characters, for the custom profile, for example -XX0100-.

settings.label: Custom user agent
settings.help: For the custom profile.

settings.label: Default mode
settings.help: seed_only, partial_seed or download_and_seed (loopback_pair is not built yet). Applied when a torrent is switched on. Default: seed_only.

settings.label: Default peer count
settings.help: Simulated peers per torrent, 1 to 20. Default: 1.

settings.label: Partial seed share (%)
settings.help: How much of the torrent a partial_seed peer starts with. Default: 50.

settings.label: Announce interval (ms)
settings.help: Typical time between announces. Default: 30000.

settings.label: Announce jitter (%)
settings.help: How far each gap may stray from the interval. Default: 25.

settings.label: Longest first delay (ms)
settings.help: Each peer waits a random time up to this before its first announce. Default: 15000.

settings.label: Follow the tracker's interval
settings.help: Use the interval the tracker answers with instead of the one above.

settings.label: Upload rate profile
settings.help: constant_jitter, random_walk or bursty. Default: bursty.

settings.label: Upload min (KB/s)
settings.help: Default: 100.

settings.label: Upload max (KB/s)
settings.help: Default: 800.

settings.label: Download rate profile
settings.help: constant_jitter, random_walk or bursty. Only for modes that download. Default: random_walk.

settings.label: Download min (KB/s)
settings.help: Default: 20.

settings.label: Download max (KB/s)
settings.help: Default: 500.

settings.label: Keep counters across restarts
settings.help: On by default. Switch it off to start from zero every time (logged).

settings.label: Send the started event
settings.help: On by default.

settings.label: Scrape the tracker
settings.help: Also ask for the torrent's scrape now and then.

settings.label: Scrape interval (ms)
settings.help: Default: 120000.

settings.label: Info hash encoding
settings.help: raw (the standard) or hex, for a tracker that expects the hash as text. Default: raw.

settings.label: API key parameter
settings.help: Query parameter that carries the tracker API key below. Default: apikey.

settings.label: Extra query parameters
settings.help: Added to every tracker request, for example passkey=abc123.

settings.label: Data folder
settings.help: Where state.json is kept. Default: the data folder inside the plugin's folder.

settings.label: Log level
settings.help: error, warn, info or debug. Default: info.
